Your fingerprint data was removed or changed in Settings, so Fingerprints has been turned off in Notes.

Make sure you remember your password. If you forget it, you won\'t be able to unlock your notes. Locked notes can\'t be restored from a backup or moved to a new phone, and they are lost if the app is reinstalled.
